svg.title: Zero trust: every request is checked, and access is to one application at a time
svg.desc: Left, the old perimeter model: once inside, a compromised host can reach everything. Right, zero trust: a user and device send each request to a policy enforcement point, which asks the policy decision point to evaluate identity, device health, location, time, and data sensitivity, and then connects the user only to the one application allowed. Trust is re-evaluated continuously and can be revoked mid-session.
svg.text: Zero trust: every request is checked, and access is to one application at a time

g.text: inside = trusted: one compromised host reaches everything
continuous verification: posture or behavior changes,
and access steps down or is revoked mid-session
VPN: authenticate once, broad network reach. ZTNA: verify each request, reach one app, resources invisible until authorized.
